item.title: DEFTONES Drop Video For New Single 'MY MIND IS A MOUNTAIN'; VIDEO
item.description: Deftones have released a new music video for their latest single, My Mind Is a Mountain (watch below). The track is part of their upcoming album Private Music, which is set to be released on August 22 through Reprise and Warner Records.

item.title: Deftones Announce 2026 European and UK Tour With Denzel Curry and Drug Church
item.description: Deftones are heading back to Europe in 2026. The Sacramento-based alternative metal band has confirmed a 15-date arena tour across Europe and the United Kingdom in support of their upcoming album Private Music.

item.title: DEFTONES Return With New Album PRIVATE MUSIC And First Single 'MY MIND IS A MOUNTAIN'; VIDEO
item.description: Deftones are officially back. The California alt-metal band has announced their new album, private music, and dropped its lead single, “my mind is a mountain,” along with a brand-new music video (watch below).

item.title: DEFTONES Tease Possible NEW SONG Or ALBUM Release With Cryptic Message During London Show
item.description: Deftones may be getting ready to release new music. During their concert at Crystal Palace Park in London on June 29, the band displayed a graphic on large screens near the stage.
